title: The Missing Cider Jug
scene: Between 1:10 and 1:30 PM, the trophy cider jug vanished from the cellar. The barn has a door chime and faces the orchard.

suspects.name: Helen Price
suspects.testimony: I labeled bottles in the barn from 1:05 to 1:35 PM, completely alone the whole time.
suspects.alibiProof: The barn door chime stayed silent, and a farmhand saw Helen labeling alone at 1:20 PM.

suspects.name: Polly Drake
suspects.testimony: I pruned apple trees right outside the open barn doors from 1:05 to 1:35 PM; only Helen was inside.
suspects.alibiProof: A tour wagon passed Polly pruning outside the barn at 1:15 and 1:30 PM.

suspects.name: Walter Boone
suspects.testimony: I swept the stone steps right outside the cellar door from 1:10 to 1:30 PM.
suspects.alibiProof: Two delivery drivers stepped past Walter sweeping the cellar steps between 1:10 and 1:30 PM.

suspects.name: Caleb Ward
suspects.testimony: I was in the barn with Helen from 1:05 to 1:35 PM, helping her stack the cider crates.
suspects.contradiction: Polly saw Helen alone in the barn, and the trophy jug was tucked under Caleb's hay bale.
